digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify testing and Pandoc corpus verification
propositions: Complete real-Pandoc corpus replay currently runs thousands of subprocess conversions on macOS critical path, consuming at least 184.32 seconds per run across two visible corpus phases.

Current ADR 0095 mandates every conversion assertion use the real Pandoc binary; moving corpus replay to external integration requires a narrow superseding ADR that preserves production renderer invariants and every assertion class.

Three representative live corpus bodies (code_arrow, table, prose) plus compact provenance probes remain in Gerrit Verify against committed deterministic outputs; complete replay moves to a dedicated weekly/manual job in external-integration workflow.

External Integration Tests workflow is currently Ubuntu-only; future implementation must add explicit pandoc-corpus-replay matrix job with os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest] arms to verify version drift and platform-specific binary fingerprints.

Documentation-only ADR changes (supersession notice in ADR 0095, new ADR 0096, updated docs/architecture.md) require Gerrit HOLD approval and must pass ADR numbering guards before implementation begins.
